RESULT.unit: 2024-04-25-theory-4-dvcEDToK — the LONGEST call in the corpus
RESULT.submitted: the REMUXED .mka, 280.7 MB — what section 7.1 and 7.2 actually submit

THE_HEADLINE_CORRECTION.was: 273.7x margin, derived by extrapolating a 126x realtime factor measured on a 68-minute, 124.5 MB file
THE_HEADLINE_CORRECTION.now: 5.7x margin, MEASURED on the longest unit in the corpus
THE_HEADLINE_CORRECTION.why_the_extrapolation_was_wrong: It extrapolated from a mid-sized file to a 4x longer, 12x larger one and was off by a factor of 48. The real answer was available for $1.54 and was not available any other way.
THE_HEADLINE_CORRECTION.lesson: A margin calculated for the worst case is not a margin. The 273x figure would have been quoted in section 7.2 as though it were established.

WHY_TAKE_1_FAILED_AND_WHAT_IT_PROVES.take_1: raw source MP4, 1,539.3 MB, TimeoutError after >1,800 s
WHY_TAKE_1_FAILED_AND_WHAT_IT_PROVES.bandwidth_was_never_the_problem: The .mka uploaded at 150.8 MB/s, so 1,539 MB would have been ~10 s of transfer. The body was not slow to send.
WHY_TAKE_1_FAILED_AND_WHAT_IT_PROVES.the_actual_difference: The raw MP4 still contains its h264 VIDEO TRACK. The remux strips it with -vn. The plan was already correct and I had deviated from it.
WHY_TAKE_1_FAILED_AND_WHAT_IT_PROVES.the_deviation_was_my_bug: My probe looked for the remuxed file inside /home/azureuser/remux/dvcEDToK/, but the remux script writes outputs to /home/azureuser/remux/ TOP LEVEL. The lookup silently fell through to the source. A fallback to a DIFFERENT file than the one intended is worse than a hard failure, because it produced a confident negative result about the plan.
WHY_TAKE_1_FAILED_AND_WHAT_IT_PROVES.WHAT_IT_PROVES_ANYWAY: The remux is MANDATORY, not an optimisation. 133 of 230 in-scope units are MP4. If the pipeline submitted them raw, they would fail this way — and under Constraint 7 each failure is paid-and-unrecoverable with no recovery path.
WHY_TAKE_1_FAILED_AND_WHAT_IT_PROVES.revised_justification_for_remux: section 7.1 previously justified -vn -c:a copy on UPLOAD TIME and file size. The measured justification is stronger: submitting a raw MP4 does not complete at all.

STILL_UNKNOWN.was_take_1_billed: The 1,539 MB failure may or may not have been charged. GET /v1/balances returns 404 on this key, so it cannot be determined from here. The operator must check. Worst case $1.54.
STILL_UNKNOWN.why_it_matters: A timeout is NOT a clean zero. It is PAID_UNKNOWN. The money gate must classify it that way rather than as 'nothing spent'. This was added to the plan as a finding from take 1.

PLAN_CHANGES: section 7.2: '273.7x' replaced with the MEASURED 5.7x, with take 1's failure recorded alongside it
